This '''species''' was a [[Sentience|sentient]] [[species]] that existed in [[the galaxy]].<ref name="Welcome to the Rebellion" />

==Biology and appearance==
This [[humanoid]] [[Sentience|sentient]] [[species]] was distinguished by their [[Color|light]] tan and pink skin, with sunken [[eye]]s, two-pronged [[ear]]s, flat [[Nose|nasal]] bridges, and white "mutton chops-style" facial [[hair]]. The species' head shared some visual similarity<ref name="Welcome to the Rebellion" /> with that of the [[Tarlafar]]s.<ref name="IdentityEG">{{SW|url=series/the-bad-batch/identity-crisis-episode-guide|text="Identity Crisis" Episode Guide | Star Wars: The Bad Batch}}</ref>

==Species in the galaxy==
In [[2 BBY]],<ref name="WTTRDate">{{AndorDate|209}}</ref> a member of this species, [[Nico]], served as a [[senator]] in the [[Imperial Senate]], delivering a speech within the [[Imperial Senate Building|Senate Building]] on the [[planet]] [[Coruscant]], honoring the [[Galactic Empire|Imperials]] who had lost their lives during the events of what would come to be known as the [[Ghorman Massacre]].<ref name="Welcome to the Rebellion" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:NicoConcept-IvanManzella.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Concept art by Ivan Manzella.]]
This species made their debut in the [[Welcome to the Rebellion|ninth episode]] of the [[Andor Season 2|second season]] of the television series ''[[Star Wars: Andor]]'',<ref name="Welcome to the Rebellion" /> directed by [[Janus Metz]] and aired on [[May 6]], [[2025]].<ref name="Trailer News">{{SW|url=news/andor-season-2-teaser-trailer-key-art-reveal|text=First ''Andor A Star Wars Story'' Teaser Trailer and Poster Revealed}}</ref> This species was designed by concept artist and sculptor [[Ivan Manzella]].<ref name="Manzella">{{WebCite|url=https://www.krop.com/ivanmanzella|text=Ivan Manzella Creature & Character Designs|author=[[Ivan Manzella|Manzella, Ivan]]|work=[https://www.krop.com Krop]|archivedate=20250715083228}}</ref>
